definitionZh: 当 eventOptions.capture 设置为 true 时，[将捕获事件](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/JavaScript/Building_blocks/Events#Event_bubbling_and_capture)。
sourceDefinition: When eventOptions.capture is set to true, [events will be captured](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/JavaScript/Building_blocks/Events#Event_bubbling_and_capture).
